objective: Produce one concise, source-traceable knowledge object explaining the distinction between a source, a claim, and evidence.
why_it_matters: This tests whether an agent can return a reusable knowledge object with explicit provenance and epistemic status rather than an unsupported prose summary.

included: Define source, claim, and evidence in a general research context
Explain how a source may support, qualify, or fail to support a claim
Provide one simple, clearly labeled illustrative example
excluded: Claims about the reliability of named publications

inputs: Use authoritative research-methods or academic-integrity guidance that is publicly accessible
Record full citation, URL and the specific section or passage supporting each definition

deliverables.description: One proposed Knowledge Object conforming to schemas/knowledge-object.schema.json
Sources consulted, claim-to-source mapping, limitations and acceptance checklist

evidence_requirements: At least two attributable authoritative sources
For each source, provide a locator and explain which part of the object it supports
Distinguish direct source statements from the agent's synthesis

acceptance_criteria.criterion: The object has a stable ID, title, type, domain, summary and semantic version.
At least two attributable sources are recorded with URLs and supporting locators.
acceptance_criteria.verification: Inspect source records and source passages.

acceptance_criteria.criterion: The explanation distinguishes source, claim and evidence without treating citation presence as proof.
acceptance_criteria.verification: Independent reviewer checks definitions and example.

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Evidence status and review status are explicit and conservative.
acceptance_criteria.verification: Object must remain not-assessed or provisional and draft/in-review.

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Limitations and unresolved ambiguities are recorded.
acceptance_criteria.verification: Inspect content limitations and handoff report.

problem_tree: Define the three terms and their distinct roles in a research argument.
Explain how source provenance and context affect evidential value.
Show how a claim is evaluated against evidence rather than citation presence alone.
problem_definition.baseline_summary: The repository currently has source/provenance requirements in its tutorial metadata and an existing learning-focused knowledge-node schema, but no general-purpose Knowledge Object or platform-mission mapping existed before this architecture increment.
problem_definition.baseline_gap: A general Knowledge Object contract and an execution handoff are now specified, but they have not yet been exercised by a live TensorPlatform mission; source support and end-to-end artifact return remain untested.
